title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations Billing Note: The Calibration Acceptance Amount
content:
The acceptance amount is half the calibration quote plus the balance standing on the order (its charges less its write-offs, transfers and payments), rounded to the cent, half up. The calibration quote is the tier's calibration price.

This is the amount a customer pays to accept the calibration on an ADAS Sensor Calibrations customer-pay order.

## Quantities, defined

- **Calibration quote:** the tier's calibration price, in US dollars, rounded to the cent, half up.
- **Share collected:** half (0.5) of the calibration quote.
- **Balance standing on the order:** the total of the order's charges, less the total of its write-offs (of every reason), less the total of its transfers onto an insurance claim repair order, less the total of its payments. It is added whether it is an amount owed or a credit: a credit lowers the acceptance amount.
- **Acceptance amount:** half the calibration quote, plus the balance standing on the order; that sum is rounded to the cent, half up (a figure short of the half cent by no more than 0.0001 of a cent is treated as reaching it).

## Worked figures (hypothetical: calibration price 349.00 USD, so half the quote is 174.50 USD)

| Charges on the order | Write-offs | Transfers | Payments | Balance standing | Acceptance amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | none | none | none | 0.00 | 174.50 |
| 210.00 | 12.00 | none | 100.00 | 98.00 owed | 272.50 |
| none | none | none | 50.00 | 50.00 credit | 124.50 |

Worked through for the second row: 210.00 less 12.00 less 100.00 is 98.00 owed; 174.50 plus 98.00 is 272.50 USD.
